summary: Backend testing for Moi Demain V1 complete. Created pytest suite covering 17 test cases across all 7 API endpoints (root, secteurs, metiers list/detail, reference, simulation preview, ressources). All 17 tests passed on first run. Verified 100 métiers, 12 secteurs seeded correctly, filtering by sector (tech=13, sante=11), text search, related métiers (6 same-sector), reference lookups, simulation preview with paris/moyenne fallback, and 404 error paths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `clean()` helper is defined but never used and its dict-comprehension keeps `_id` due to `k != '_id' or True` always True — dead/misleading code, safe to remove.

list_metiers projection is `{'_id': 0, ...}` combined with inclusion fields — MongoDB allows this specific exception but mixing exclusions/inclusions is fragile; consider excluding _id only or listing explicit inclusions without _id:0.
Text search endpoint builds a regex on client-provided input; a text index exists on nom/motsCles/secteur_label but is unused. Consider $text search for performance and relevance ranking.
seed_data() uses upsert-once via marker — if source_data.json changes, DB won't refresh unless meta.seeded_v1 is deleted. Consider a version hash to auto-reseed on data change.
CORS_ORIGINS default is '*' with allow_credentials=True — this combination is invalid per CORS spec and browsers may reject. Explicit origins recommended for production.
seed_data_creation: none - relied on existing seeded DB (100 métiers, 12 secteurs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all 7 endpoints; reuse as regression suite. All 17 assertions pass. MongoDB is seeded once via `meta.seeded_v1` marker — to force reseed, drop that doc.
